en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a canal lock with stone gates and water in the foreground, bordered by a tree‑lined promenade with large classical buildings on the left and an iron railing bridge with gas-style street lamps on the right. Several people stand on the bridge and near the lock machinery. The image is oval‑framed on a light background, with red printed text at the bottom identifying the scene.
